description: Recorded model responses for the capability-ceiling arm, which authorizes every action the world contains and briefs the model on the task without mentioning authorization at all. They walk the same route as the fast-route recording and declare no scope on any call, because a model given no authorization statement has no belief about scope to state. What this file is for is the reading the matched pair is measured against: the fraction of agents that can work the mechanism when nothing discourages them.
